Wipe saliva off with cloth, tissue, or gauze. Teeth must be completely dry for Toothpolish to stick. 3. Paint Toothpolish. Apply in thin layers. To avoid streaking, paint 1-3 strokes per tooth. It is important to allow at least 10 seconds dry time between layers. Polish is dry when hardened. Not dry = soft/jelly. Keep product clean. After polishing each tooth, wipe brush off on a disposable cloth or gauze before dipping it back into the bottle. Wiping brush, brush arm, and bottle edge with high-proof alcohol is also recommended. Do not leave brushes out too long since they will dry & harden. 4. Fix it. Use a toothpick to remove excess polish from gums and gaps. Polish is easier to manipulate when wet. As with any technique, practice practice practice! Enjoy any drink while smiling wild. Toothpolish will last while eating soft foods only. Take Toothpolish with you to reapply after some meals, just like you do with lipstick. TO REMOVE Chip it off. Use your clean fingernail to chip off the polish. Or cover your finger with a cloth, tissue, or gauze. It is easiest to remove Toothpolish when polish is completely dry. To remove excess flakes, brush & floss teeth. description: Iso E Super is an aroma-chemical, which, on its own, is less of a fragrance than an effect. Almost transparent in colour it has a vague sweet cedarwood-like scent imparting a male, woodsy, musky type aroma. It is known as the invisible fragrance, and has also been likened to a modern day Love Potion No.9! The reason for this is that it has been known to mimic the action of human pheromones. Although not a pheromone itself, it has the effect of other people noticing you or your fragrance but not quite being able to put their finger on the reason why. This is because ordinary fragrances are designed to project themselves over a wide radius, whilst Iso E Super is designed to cling to the skin, swapping itself between opulence and simplicity, sometimes being quite noticeable, sometimes undetectable. The wearer may notice a subtle, velvety, woody note which will vanish, then re-surface after some time. More than this, she or he will notice the impact the fragrance has on other people, because Iso E Super lends an indefinable allure to the wearer. In fact, its effect is almost pheromonic.

Richard Schmid Paints The Landscape Series - Set of 4 DVD's - Includes; November, May, June, & White Pine
description: NOVEMBER is the first in a four part series of landscape instruction videos addressing the various aspects and unique challenges of landscape painting. Working in the freezing cold and intermittent snowfalls of Vermont's early winter, Richard delivers his painting techniques with a great sense of humor as he deals with the elements. Special features include a Q & A session as well as a gallery of Richard Schmid's landscape paintings. JUNE, the second installment in the four part landscape instruction series, features two painting instruction sessions beginning with a very intense morning session of bright outdoor painting from life. The second painting session continues in Richard's studio with an aesthetic and technical analysis of the morning's work, and soon develops into a fascinating tour de force of palette knife and transparent wash painting combined. MAY, the third installment in the four part landscape instruction series, joins Richard and friends as he deals with the task of painting with bright sunlight on his canvas. He then takes us to his studio to finish his painting. Along the way, enjoy and learn as the artist leads us through the landscape painting process with technical expertise, artistic virtuosity and thoughtful philosophy. WHITE PINE, the final installment in the four part landscape instruction series, explores the use of modern technology and photos in painting. The advantages of using a computer instead of older methods are demonstrated in complete detail. As he paints, Richard Schmid explains about color harmony, design, edges, values. He demonstrates how he departs from the photograph then borrows elements from other images to reach his goal.

The Czech Republic is where the world's foremost glass artisans reside. These crystal glass files reflect the expertise of these highly skilled, glass artisans. What differentiates these Czech files from the imitations made in China and elsewhere, is that Czech files have their gritty surface produced by mechanically etching the crystal glass surface. As a result, these Czech files will never wear out. They can be cleaned and will work just like brand new, over and over again! This crystal glass etching process is time consuming, requires great skill, and is expensive. The less expensive glass files, produced in China and elsewhere, have grit bonded with adhesives to the glass surface. These adhesive grit Chinese files wear out, unlike the Czech Republic files. The inspection and quality control process involved in these Czech Republic crystal glass files is outstanding! It is second to none! As a result of their anticipated longevity, these Czech files are considered "green," or eco-friendly. Each individual file comes with its own durable, protective, clear, vinyl storage case. Our facial cups are designed specifically to enhance the face, neck and jawline by boosting cellular turnover, promoting circulation, and lifting and plumping the face. Use this squeeze and release technique in light sweeping strokes in an upward motion, from chin to temple. The second technique is the staccato technique; squeeze the large cup in an area you want to focus on (jawline, cheek, 11 lines, smile lines, etc) and squeeze and release the cup in short, quick bursts. The small cups are very useful for targeting the delicate eyes and lips. They can be used in a targeted fashion to address and "erase" fine lines in the forehead, laugh lines and to boost the plumpness of the lips. After cupping, smooth in remaining facial oil. Remember the cups are very strong thus it is essential that you NEVER leave the cup in one area on your face for more than a second or two or you can bruise your skin. Our cups can be used daily as part of your personal skincare routine. It only takes a few minutes to bring out your natural glow. Our kit includes 2 large and 2 small facial cups in an compact box.

name: Comedone Extractor for Blackheads, Blemish, Pimples, Acne, Whitehead and More! 6 Skincare Tools with a Premium Case Included! 100%! Best Blackhead Remover!
description: iElegance is bringing to you the ideal comedone solution so you can have beautiful, blemish free skin and the newfound confidence to go with it Great, but there are SO many tools, how do you use each? • Double loop extractor: Shaped like a stretched out oval. Designed to apply light pressure to the skin to release the comedone. Place gently on top of the comedone and rock the tool back and forth to build pressure and concentrate sebum in one location. There are 4 different sizes included in the iElegance kit. Use the size best suited to the size of the comedone. • Angled double loop extractor: Shaped like a double loop extractor but at a slight angle. Designed to function similarly but for harder to reach areas. • Spoon shaped extractor: Shaped like a small spoon with a hole in the middle. Designed to fit over blackhead and when pressed down with light pressure, results in excretion of the blackhead. • Lancet: Shaped like a sharp, pointed arrow. Used to pick mature pimples that have developed a head. • Single loop extractor: Shaped like a fine hollow circle. Used to press onto comedone and extract impurities. Can be used for harder to reach areas e.g. side of the nose. How to use: • Step 1: Sterilise tools with alcohol or hot water. • Step 2: Prep your face by cleansing with lukewarm water. Or hold a warm damp cloth to the area for a few minutes to open up pores. • Step 3: Using the double loop extractor, gently place on top of the pimple and rock back and forth to build pressure or concentrate sebum / dirt. • Step 4: Gently press down on one side of the pimple using the single loop extractor, move the tool across the top (you may need to adjust the angle. Applying even pressure, slide the edge of the loop and the pimple is removed). • Step 5: Cleanse your skin again, then apply toner and moisturizer. • Step 6: Disinfect tools with alcohol.

name: Exfoliating & Clarifying UltraMUD - Enhanced with salicylic, tea tree, glycolic, mandelic, and azelaic
description: Salicylic acid, a Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA) is oil-soluble which makes it ideal for the acne-prone. It reduces oiliness and pore build-up since it is able to penetrate through the oil unlike its AHA counterpart. This aids in reducing sebaceous follicle blockage to help reduce the occurrence of future breakouts. Glycolic acid is an AHA that is best for improving texture and reducing the appearance of lines. Derived from sugar cane, glycolic acid’s anti-aging benefits come from its small molecular size that can deeply penetrate the skin. It’s useful for a host of skin conditions from pigmentation issues, uneven texture, acne scarring, and wrinkles and fine lines. Mandelic acid helps treat a wide range of issues from acne, scarring, fine lines and wrinkles. Because it has a larger molecular size compared to other AHAs, it is able to gently exfoliate the skin with less chance of post-peel inflammation or hyperpigmentation. Azelaic acid is naturally found in grains like rye, wheat, and barley. It is a dicarboxylic acid and is especially good at evening out pigmentation and improving skin tone. It blocks keratin production which can help lessen the occurence of clogged pores and help reduce breakouts. Tea tree oil has been proven effective in reducing acne bacteria and is a natural alternative to benzoyl peroxide. It is an essential oil extracted from the leaves of the Melaleuca Alternifolia tree native to Australia.

Makeup artists at photo shoots and those working backstage during Fashion Week have sworn by micellar water’s ability to get rid of makeup without the use of water. Micellar water gets its name from the science behind the product. It’s made of “micelles,” which are tiny oil molecules suspended in water. description: What is the MJ-90? We took the ever popular DE89 razor head, studied it, analyzed all it's positive and negative qualities and made it WAY better! What did we do and why is it better? 1) Materials: Instead of low-quality zinc-alloy (Zamak/pot metal), we used aircraft aluminum block for the head and 316L stainless steel rod for the handle. 2) Build: Instead of cheap, non-precise stamping/casting, we have built the razor using precision CNC milling, both for the head and handle. The tolerances are superior to the DE89. 3) Design: Instead of having the blade tabs exposed, we have milled the tolerances of the guideposts to precisely hold the blade with very little blade play, meaning the blade tabs can be covered, protecting your precious ear lobes :) 4) Longevity: The DE89 is well known for its threaded post snapping off. Why? Because it uses cheap pot metal and because it's post is spot welded on. Drop it from 12-18 inches and the post breaks off into the handle rendering your $40-45 razor useless and ready for the landfill. We completely milled the top cap from a block of aircraft aluminum, meaning the top cap is one solid piece, no broken posts here! 5) Handle: Instead of using a hollow cheap handle, we have milled our handle from solid 316L marine-grade stainless steel and hand polished it. We have also milled in our RazoRock Halo rings for extreme grip and comfort! 6) Price: Even though we made all the necessary improvements above, it sells for only $39.99! How does this even make sense when the competition is selling a far inferior product for $35-60? I'll leave that with you to ponder :) With the RazoRock brand, our goal is to make things better and less expensive.
